api_url.description: URL of the asciinema-server instance (e.g., asciinema.org or self-hosted instance). Overrides ASCIINEMA_API_URL env var.

cols.description: Override terminal columns for recordings (0 = auto-detect from TTY).

rows.description: Override terminal rows for recordings (0 = auto-detect from TTY).

idle_time_limit.description: Limit recorded terminal inactivity to max N seconds (fractional seconds supported). Applied during recording and replay.

env.description: List of environment variable names to capture during recording (in addition to SHELL and TERM). Must be names only, no values.

title.description: Default title for new recordings (can be overridden via -t option).

config_home.description: Override config directory location. Ignored by asciinema itself (use ASCIINEMA_CONFIG_HOME env var instead); only used here to render correct path.
